beaches.name: Falassarna (north end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the northern end of the main beach, among the rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2018 that conflict: some find the area fully clothed, others up to 20% nude; a 2010-11 report mentions a nudist-beach sign later removed, and a 2021 directory entry claims a sign. No designation is documented.
